actions.scope: Source MAIN; canonical owners/map/hero/items, native command widths/lifetime and zero pre-byte C allocation; actual creation/read/feel/wipe/seeded and RNG degradation, forgetting/sanitizing, nonempty source save/release and opposite-engine raw-byte restore. All world graphs, both ISAAC states/logs, terminal/frame/input compare. Serialized pointers normalize only observed list IDs and text offsets; all other bytes compare exactly. Other tools/forms/terrain, every callback/menu branch and hidden recordings are not claimed.

public44.scope: One unprofiled candidate against existing evidence; separate single runs, not a controlled speedup. Candidate is slower.
